-- RTI: avg func_impv * TAR where TAR = compliant / total_outcomes

    SELECT f.fac_key,
           AVG(CASE 
               WHEN t.th_eng = 'High' THEN 3
               WHEN t.th_eng = 'Medium' THEN 2
               WHEN t.th_eng = 'Low' THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END) as tes,
           AVG(CASE 
               WHEN LOWER(txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') IN ('significant', 'moderate', 'minimal') THEN 
                   CASE LOWER(txprogmet->>'Func_Impv')
                       WHEN 'significant' THEN 3
                       WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2

    JOIN encounters e ON e.clin_id = c.clin_key
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
    JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.tx_ref = t.tx_key
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
)
